mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.order_id, c.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.image AS product_image, c.shop_id, s.shop_name, c.user_id, u.username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, c.content, c.images, c.score, c.status, c.reply, c.reply_time, c.create_time FROM comment c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop s ON c.shop_id = s.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
